name: auspex-vscode
description: Reports live editor state and deep debug sessions — open files, caret, selection, unsaved buffers, diagnostics, call stacks, variables and the whole debug protocol timeline — to a local Auspex server, so an AI assistant can read what you are actually looking at.

auspex.enabled.description: Report editor state to the local Auspex server. Turning this off stops all reporting immediately.

auspex.endpoint.description: Where to post. A loopback address by default; nothing is ever sent off this machine unless you change this.

auspex.intervalSeconds.description: Heartbeat interval. State is also pushed immediately whenever the caret, the open tabs or the diagnostics change.

auspex.includeUnsavedText.description: Include the contents of unsaved buffers. These exist only in the editor's memory, so this is the only way anything else can see them. Saved files are never sent — they are already readable from disk.

auspex.maxTextBytes.description: Largest unsaved buffer to send, in bytes.

auspex.trackDebugSessions.description: Capture debug sessions from inside the editor. This needs no configuration and works for every debugger, but it can only see what the editor asked for — a variable nobody expanded was never sent over the wire. For every scope of every frame, deep variable trees and memory, run `auspex proxy --dap --deep` instead.
